label: Kitchen counter, L-shaped

stretch.how: each leg extends independently from the corner, which stays fixed at the origin

clearance.reason: working at the counter with a door behind you

notes: The most common PH kitchen form — 29 of the 79 precedent records describe the counter as an L, against 2 galley and 2 single-wall. Wants a CORNER, two walls meeting at the origin. `w`/`d` are the bounding box; `cells` gives the two legs. The dashed square at the corner is the blind cabinet, reachable from one leg only — so put the sink on one leg and the range on the other rather than either side of the corner. Handed: mirror for the other hand.
